sources_considered.why: Primary professional co-writing study. Its 2022 observations are historical context, not July 2023 outcome evidence.
Contemporaneous firsthand reporting on a generated episode provides a material challenge to an overly broad inability claim.
Read the primary technical account, but the page mentions earlier versions without establishing the publication date of the displayed version.
Its August 2023 webpage date does not make the underlying 2022 study a new capability observation.

evidence_items.explanation: The study involved 15 theatre and film professionals and demonstrated collaborative writing. It neither tested independent replacement nor established the capabilities of systems available in July 2023.

A reporter viewed a generated five-minute South Park imitation and found it watchable. The article also describes human previewing and an unreleased demonstration; it does not establish independent performance of a professional writer's full duties.

unresolved_gaps: No representative July 2023 evaluation measures independent performance of professional screenwriting duties.
The demonstration does not disclose enough about selection, failed attempts or professional acceptance to establish replacement.
The older co-writing study cannot establish a general inability in July 2023.
